name: Mem0
purpose: Long-term memory layer for agents: extraction, storage, and retrieval of user/agent memories; self-host or use the hosted platform.

name: Letta
purpose: Stateful-agent platform (the MemGPT lineage): agents with self-editing long-term memory and persistence.

name: Zep
purpose: Long-term memory for AI agents built on a temporal knowledge graph (Graphiti); session/context assembly for production apps.

name: Cognee
purpose: Open-source memory layer that builds a knowledge graph from documents and conversations for agent recall (ECL pipeline).

name: Graphiti (Zep)
purpose: Temporal knowledge-graph engine for agent memory — the open core under Zep; tracks facts as they change over time.

name: LangMem (LangChain)
purpose: LangChain's memory toolkit: extract, store, and retrieve long-term memories for LangGraph agents.
